title: Translation Alignment, Interlinear Glossing & Parallel Corpora
query: How do the Leipzig Glossing Rules and TEI linguistic alignment standards structure word-level glossing and sentence-level translation alignment in digital critical editions, and how do automated aligners and LLMs compare?

results.authors_venue_year: Prompt and circumstance: A word-by-word LLM prompting approach to interlinear glossing for low-resource languagesM Elsner, D Liu - … of the 22nd SIGMORPHON workshop on …, 2025 - aclanthology.orgAdheres to the Leipzig glossing format (Bickel et al., 2015) by using interlinear glossed text and following the conventions for interlinear morpheme-by-morpheme glosses.LLM Instructions for Glossing: Instructs the LLM system to use Leipzig tagging conventions, specifically mandating function tags over English morphology for grammatical information, when glossing target words.Automated Aligner/LLM Comparison: Demonstrates that a retrieval-based LLM system outperforms the BERT-based shared task baseline for every language in the morpheme-level score category and achieves higher word-level scores than the challenge winner in five languages, showcasing the competitive performance of LLMs in automated glossing.Save Cite Cited by 6 Related articles All 4 versions  No full text available View as HTML [PDF] rutgers.edu

results.title: Greek, Latin and Augmented Intelligence: The Other Ai
results.authors_venue_year: Greek, Latin and Augmented Intelligence: The Other AiG Crane, A Babeu, F Shamsian - The Classical Review, 2025 - cambridge.orgDiscusses two key technologies for making source texts accessible: word and phrase level aligned translations and rich linguistic annotations (treebanks) that explain the part of speech, dictionary form, and syntactic function of each word.Automatic vs. Manual Alignment: Compares manual alignment, which yields more precise data and serves as a pedagogical tool, with automatic alignment, which processes large bodies of text despite having a substantial error rate.Role of Language Models: Indicates that automatic alignment is improving through new generations of models that benefit from access to language models, allowing the aligner to recognize words with similar meanings and achieve higher correctness rates.Save Cite Cited by 2 Related articles All 2 versions  [PDF] aclanthology.org

results.title: Structure-guided generation and verification: constructing high-quality parallel corpora for low-resource agglutinative languages
results.authors_venue_year: [HTML][HTML] Structure-guided generation and verification: constructing high-quality parallel corpora for low-resource agglutinative languagesY Qi, A Murat - Journal of King Saud University Computer and …, 2026 - SpringerIncorporates Interlinear Glossed Text (IGT) as a structural constraint to guide the Large Language Model (LLM) to follow the grammatical rules of the source language, which helps mitigate morphological hallucination in low-resource settings.Morphological Label Embedding: Reformulates candidate generation from an unconstrained translation task into a linguistically grounded structural inference problem by embedding morphological labels from IGT into the prompt, explicitly guiding the LLM to preserve fine-grained grammatical distinctions like case and definiteness.LLM Performance Comparison: Compares LLM-based translation performance against competitive baselines for corpus construction, such as the LASER and LaBSE mining strategies, finding that the structure-guided framework significantly outperforms them.Save Cite Related articles All 2 versions
